title: Turn anything
text:
NPCs and objects can now be turned in the World Editor, and every street lamp in Hearthmere can be moved.

✨ World Editor: turn NPCs, market stalls, crate stacks, Southlands props and your own props. Drag the blue handle on the map, press R (Shift+R turns the other way), or set the angle in the Inspector
✨ World Editor: NPCs get a Facing setting. They rest facing that way and still turn to look at you when you come close. A small tick on the map shows which way each one faces
✨ World Editor: the chapel's lamps, the tavern lamp and the lamps along the ring street can now be moved and removed like the other street lamps
